disposition_reason: Table 3 prints mean ± SD concentrations of ten elements in 18 brand and age-group combinations of powdered infant formula sold in Kirsehir, Turkey.

study.design: Retail survey of powdered infant formula (6 brands x 3 age groups x 2 production dates)
study.market: Supermarkets and pharmacies, Kirsehir province, Turkey
study.method: Microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion of 0.25-0.30 g; HR-CS flame AAS (Analytik Jena ContrAA 300); N2O-acetylene flame for Al
lod: LOD in solution (3 sigma, 11 repetitions): Pb 5, Ni 1.2, Cd 0.4, Al 22, Cr 5, Cu 1, Fe 1, Mn 1, Zn 1, Co 2 µg/L
study.qa: Standard addition recoveries above 90%; no CRM reported; blanks digested
